claims.location: source name, comment[data file], factor value[sample class], rows 1-11
claims.value: Ten historical beeswax subsamples B1-B11 except B4 and one extraction blank
claims.evidence: Deposited Raw_File_Sample_Key.txt explicitly maps these eleven run stems to the Beeswax Feasibility Test, ten wax subsamples and one lab blank; all eleven stems match the accession-matched PRIDE RAW file list.

claims.value: Apis mellifera source material for beeswax; not applicable for blank
claims.evidence: The project describes historical honeycomb specimens of honeybees and its structured organism is Apis mellifera; the extraction blank has no organism. The recovered peptide mixture can include proteins from other organisms, but the sampled source material is honeybee wax.

The PRIDE sample-processing paragraph for historical beeswax states that beeswax samples and the procedural extraction blank were digested overnight with trypsin. Its separate queen-cell paragraph describes sequential Lys-C and Trypsin, which does not apply to these eleven rows.

claims.value: Orbitrap Exploris 480, DDA, 5 ppm precursor and 20 ppm fragment
claims.evidence: PRIDE describes Exploris 480 Top 10 DDA acquisition for the wax experiments and gives 5 ppm/20 ppm tolerances for the final wax database search. Every included RAW file stem contains DDA.

claims.value: Fixed carbamidomethyl C and variable oxidation M, deamidation N/Q, pyroglutamate Q/E
claims.evidence: The PRIDE data-processing paragraph specific to wax explicitly lists these modifications for the final MaxQuant search. Unimod 7, 27, and 28 identify deamidation and the two pyroglutamate forms.

limitations: This is only the historical beeswax experiment within PXD034106. The queen-cell sample and blank, and four polymer contamination blanks, are not represented here because they use different biological material or preparation workflows.

The paper says ten wax subsamples came from six original specimens, but the deposited key does not map B1-B11 to those six specimens. Each B# is kept as its own source with biological replicate 1; no specimen-level grouping is inferred.
The wax specimens may contain plant, fungal, and human proteins; Apis mellifera denotes the honeybee-derived source material, not the full peptide taxonomic mixture.
The record's queen-cell Trypsin/Lys-C protocol does not apply to wax rows; the accession-level reconcile warning is therefore a mixed-experiment false positive.
Modification identities and 5 ppm/20 ppm tolerances are from the wax-specific PRIDE protocol; the search-parameter archive was not inspected.
